changelog: Vortex v5.5.35: switching your insta-lock agent while it is armed now re-targets the backend and confirms with a brief "Autolock updated to ..." toast (or a clear error if it fails); the Start-a-Match panel shows a PLAY action while VALORANT is closed instead of a dead Start Match button; the dashboard PLAY button now follows the active theme accent instead of always being green; and agent portraits render crisply on high-DPI displays.
